Name: Estefania Santana
Details: A descendent of one of the founding familes of the 22nd Century, who still maintin extensive holdings on the Seville continent. As with many of the large, spanish speaking minority, the Santana family has always experinced frictions with the Capellan government. In recent years, Estefania became radicalised and eventually rose to the leadership of the Free Seville movement, one of the primary revolutionary groups opposed to Capellan rule.
